        org  = "b"

    input qid      : party

        amount          = %amount
        currency        = %currency
        idempotency_key  = %key
    }
    credit c1 {
        ledger          = "l.payee"
        owner           = "payee"
        participant     = "Payee"
        party           = %qid
        amount          = %amount
        currency        = %currency
        idempotency_key  = %key

        participant     = "Payer"
        party           = %pid
        amount          = %fee

        owner           = "fee"

}
